The plumbline server refused all further connections, so the run ends here on the evidence its calls actually returned. For the record, in this run: the checkout verification passed (all 16 repos indexed, every `lastIndexedCommit` matching its pinned commit); six plumbline calls completed; the server then died mid-call on the TanStack DB search and would not reconnect, so L2 (per-repo breadth) was never spent and the defect site was never confirmed by reading source. The only file I read verbatim — jotai `src/vanilla/utils/splitAtom.ts` — I ruled out and am not naming. No pinpoints are given because no file I name was opened.
